h1: Outdoor Playground Equipment Manufacturer & Supplier in Haldia

h1Text: Outdoor Playground Equipment Manufacturer & Supplier in Haldia

items.pText: Haldia is a port and industrial town near the mouth of the Hooghly, with refineries, petrochemical plants and the townships that house their staff. A township here often has several small parks, one for each block or sector. FunPlay Systems supplies playground equipment for these sites from our factory in Vasai, about 1,610 km away, and sends it to West Bengal by road.

When one estate office looks after many parks, it pays to use the same few models in all of them. Spare parts are then common to every site, the maintenance staff learn one routine, and residents in every block get equipment of the same standard. We can plan a standard set and adapt it to the size of each park. The air here is humid and carries salt from the estuary, so we use galvanised frames and roto-moulded parts throughout.

props.h2Text: How would you like to start?
props.pText: Turn your playground dreams to reality

richText.heading: Planning one standard set for many parks

c: Start with the smallest park. Choose a core set that fits it, perhaps a play station, a swing and a spring rider, and use that as the base for every block. Larger parks can add a merry-go-round, a climber or a second station on the same drawing. Keep one colour scheme across all sites, picked from our 15+ roto-moulded shades, so replacement panels are easy to match. Rinse the equipment with fresh water now and then to clear salt deposits.

facts.label: Distance
facts.value: About 1,610 km from our Vasai factory (straight line)

facts.label: Delivery and installation
facts.value: By road from Vasai; installed by our team or a local dealer

items.q: Can you supply the same equipment to several parks in one township?
items.a: Yes. We plan a standard set, adjust it to each park's size and prepare a separate layout drawing for every site. The whole order can be made and dispatched together or in stages.

items.q: Why use the same models across all parks?
items.a: Common models mean common spare parts and one maintenance routine for your staff. Residents in every block also get the same standard of equipment, which avoids complaints about one park being better than another.

items.q: Does salt air near Haldia damage playground equipment?
items.a: Bare steel suffers, but galvanised pipe and roto-moulded plastic resist it well. Rinse the equipment with fresh water from time to time and check bolts and moving parts regularly.
